BranchListing.description: Commercial listing only; inventory_authority is always NOT_IMPLEMENTED in Part A.

Calibration.description: Product/variant and optional branch scoped approximation. It can never be treated as an exact stock conversion.

InventoryAuthority.description: Section 12A intentionally publishes no inventory authority.

ListingSellUnit.description: A sell unit selected for one branch listing. calibration_ref, when present, is an approximate calibration for that same branch only.

base_quantity.description: Exact canonical grams, millilitres or count only; always null for local containers.

MinorMoney.description: Whole minor units in server-authoritative business currency; never float.

PackageRelation.description: Explicit same-product parent/child packaging ratio; no ratio is inferred from names.

QuantityBreak.description: Inclusive, non-overlapping quantity band; null maximum is the single open-ended final band.

ResolvedPrice.description: Commercial configuration result only; never checkout, charge or stock availability.

info.description: Authenticated Shop/Grocery/Market/Wholesale management only. Supports SUPERMARKET, GROCERY_SHOP, FOODSTUFF_DEALER, MARKET_TRADER and WHOLESALER operating models subject to branch capabilities. Measurement is first-class: exact gram/millilitre/count conversions are separate from product/branch-specific calibrated approximations; PAINT, DERICA and MUDU have no universal weight. Fractional sell units use bounded numerator/denominator values. All money is integer minor units. Price history is append-only. Listings hold commercial configuration and never authoritative inventory. Section 12B inventory, stock, reservations, customer discovery, Orders, Wallet and logistics execution are not implemented here.
